reviews.scope: Source-only review before current full-app verification. Implementation was not frozen; hashes bind this snapshot, later edits require delta review.

findings.title: SDK resource plist is used as the application Info.plist
findings.evidence: Both Milo target configurations assign INFOPLIST_FILE to Vendor/AGConnect/1.9.4.300/AGCResources.bundle/Contents/Info.plist. Inspection of that actual vendor plist shows CFBundleIdentifier com.huawei.agconnect.AGConnectCredential, CFBundlePackageType BNDL, CFBundleName AGCResources and MacOSX platform metadata. XcodeGen inferred this nested resource plist while the app requests generated metadata.
findings.impact: The generated app target consumes another bundle identity/type/platform metadata, jeopardizing installation, iOS bundle configuration matching and release metadata. A SDK-only link probe does not test this app target.
findings.fix: Reference AGCResources.bundle as a bundle/file resource and prevent its Info.plist being inferred as Milo metadata; regenerate project and inspect the built app Info.plist for APPL, com.milo.echoes.ios and iOS platform.

findings.title: Remote deletion success followed by local cleanup failure cannot be retried
findings.evidence: deleteAccount always calls the remote provider before local cleanup, including after a previous remote success. AGCAuth.h documents deleteUser removes server user and cached session. Real adapter then rejects a retry when currentUser is nil. The model preserves remote identity and tells the user to retry if local callback, keychain or local file cleanup fails.
findings.impact: After a partial deletion the promised retry cannot reach the remaining local cleanup. Restart currently also loses knowledge of the completed remote step.
findings.fix: Track the remote-deletion-complete stage safely, including restart or clearly supported recovery, so retries complete local cleanup without attempting to delete a nonexistent remote user. Test remote success then local failure with a provider that loses its session; retain remote-failure no-local-delete assertions.

findings.title: Clean CI checkout lacks newly required AGC SDK installation
findings.evidence: Vendor is ignored and the project directly links four Vendor/AGConnect/1.9.4.300 xcframeworks and AGCResources.bundle. Current CI moves from npm install and gate unit tests directly to xcodebuild dependency resolution and native runner, with no SDK installer step.
findings.impact: A clean CI checkout cannot build the app against the ignored SDK files that exist on this machine.
findings.fix: Run the pinned project-local SDK installer/verification before dependency resolution/native fingerprinting; keep app-specific authentication configuration optional and separate from dependency installation.
